title: Sarah as your default companion
description: Fresh installs open with Sarah wearing her tie top, long chain pants and sandals, without a coat.
highlights: Sarah is the default avatar, with her Gleam voice.
Her default look is Tie top, chain pants & sandals, with no prop.
The installer includes encrypted Sarah and her motions; first launch briefly connects to unlock her.
Existing saved character choices and appearances are retained.
Includes the overhead input, microphone controls and independent group task updates from v0.2.14.
